scope: Only future NEW controller pure/synthetic injected interfaces under separate parent grant. No real subprocesses, compiler/shell/native/original code, proc census or namespace operations. Production APIs not yet received; binding to actual functions will be explicit.
independence: Expectations fixed before reading controller implementation; the fake process and side-effect oracles must be external to production truth-producing code. No initial import or execution authorized by this design.

tests.input_or_fault: missing external parent reference
tests.required_observation: Refuse before Popen; no self-authorized admission from file fields.

tests.input_or_fault: wrong admission digest or command/source digest
tests.required_observation: Refuse before Popen; matching version/status labels do not repair it.

tests.input_or_fault: admission internally declares approved but external reference differs
tests.required_observation: Refuse before Popen; JSON cannot mint authority.

tests.input_or_fault: extra job, reordered job, B1-B4 or original source path
tests.required_observation: Refuse before Popen; exact8 job ceiling and Gamma_probe only.

tests.input_or_fault: changed cwd/env/argv/fixture bytes/modes or controller source pin
tests.required_observation: Refuse before Popen; contextual substitutions require the trusted exact plan.

tests.input_or_fault: bool where integer required, subclass/callback key/container
tests.required_observation: Reject before comparison or callback; require exact plain types at trust boundary.

tests.input_or_fault: C00 exits97 with exact stdout and empty stderr
tests.required_observation: Expected calibration result; advance once without false generic nonzero failure.

tests.input_or_fault: C01 exits98 with exact stdout and empty stderr
tests.required_observation: Expected calibration result; advance once.

tests.input_or_fault: calibration wrong marker/exit/stderr
tests.required_observation: STOP, retain primary raw/error/status, launch no later jobs.

tests.input_or_fault: GCC exits nonzero/signal or emits unexpected stub execution marker
tests.required_observation: STOP with no retry/reroll; data unqualified.

tests.input_or_fault: T4 arrives before B5 reference
tests.required_observation: Refuse order or leave pending; no uncounted replacement reference.

tests.input_or_fault: all8 expected finite observations
tests.required_observation: Exactly8 launches in order C00,C01,T1,T2,T3,B5,T4,T5; no original base jobs, no hidden warmup.

tests.input_or_fault: stream exactly cap and EOF
tests.required_observation: Retain exact cap bytes; no overflow falsely inferred.

tests.input_or_fault: stream cap+1 byte or endless fake producer
tests.required_observation: Detect first overflow with bounded buffers/writes, STOP/cleanup; never raise cap or call truncated data complete.

tests.input_or_fault: GCC job10s/calibration5s deadline crossed
tests.required_observation: No more launches; use bounded cleanup and account failure.

tests.input_or_fault: whole150s deadline or initial-tranche balance insufficient
tests.required_observation: Refuse or STOP without borrowing2400s/retrying; include setup/observation/cleanup.

tests.input_or_fault: sampled RSS exceeds1GiB or sampler fails
tests.required_observation: STOP and preserve evidence; no hard peak/RLIMIT_AS claim from samples.

tests.input_or_fault: child attempts regular file above approved FSIZE
tests.required_observation: Resource contract defined in source; signal/error remains failed data, original cap not raised.

tests.input_or_fault: primary exits while group descendant/pipe writer remains
tests.required_observation: Detect/clean owned group within deadline or retain UNKNOWN; no direct-child-only all-joined claim.

tests.input_or_fault: timeout then kill/reap/close fails
tests.required_observation: Preserve primary error first, record secondary failures and unknown tail; no next job.

tests.input_or_fault: spawn raises after intent or at unknown partial-spawn boundary
tests.required_observation: No retry; retain spawn-entered/returned distinction, raw/identity/cost evidence, bounded owner cleanup.

tests.input_or_fault: failure before final receipt/log close
tests.required_observation: Account failed setup/control/read/write/cleanup work; original primary retained and incomplete receipt cannot mean success.

tests.input_or_fault: exit0+EOF but fake intended writer dropped earlier bytes
tests.required_observation: Receipt never infers intended-emission completeness from collector completion.

tests.input_or_fault: B5/T4 equal empty or truncated data
tests.required_observation: No full builtin-state/installed-reporter qualification or consumer inference.

tests.input_or_fault: raw reported command/path matches expected original string
tests.required_observation: No raw-to-qualified fact promotion; all fullC05/V03/runtime flags false.

tests.input_or_fault: stub marker absent in T2
tests.required_observation: At most predeclared finite observation; not global no-descendant/no-execution theorem.

tests.input_or_fault: passive ELF candidates and matching file pins
tests.required_observation: Identity evidence only; no actual loader-selected closure/C07 lifetime/currentness theorem.

tests.input_or_fault: owned filesystem new-directory/log collision or symlink
tests.required_observation: Fail closed before unsafe overwrite; preserve existing file; no deletion/reuse/automatic reroll.

tests.input_or_fault: writer FD/readback/metadata/ancestor identity ambiguity
tests.required_observation: STOP; endpoint checks not represented as interval or universal ownership proof.
